# webmcp-tour (vendored)

This folder holds a pinned copy of [webmcp-tour](https://github.com/fboldo/webmcp-tour) 0.1.0 by Filipe Boldo, MIT licence (see `LICENSE`). On a page with WebMCP, it registers four read-only tools: `tour_list_targets`, `tour_show_step`, `tour_wait_for_interaction` and `tour_dismiss`. An agent can point at a control, explain it, and wait for the reader. It navigates only when the reader presses Go.

Before vendoring, the file was read for outbound calls. It makes no fetch, XMLHttpRequest, beacon, WebSocket or dynamic import, contains no remote URL, and writes no HTML (text only). Its only storage is sessionStorage, for the one-use resume nonce. Its sha384 matches the SRI hash in the upstream README for 0.1.0.

Browsers without WebMCP ignore it. Today that means Chrome with the WebMCP flag or origin trial, or an agent that drives Chrome with WebMCP turned on.
